fields.description: Nourelle adds three connected residential buildings to Madinat Jumeirah Living in Umm Suqeim. Its skybridge brings landscaped gardens and wellness spaces above the surrounding neighbourhood. The published collection ranges from one-bedroom apartments to a larger four-bedroom residence, with outdoor areas varying considerably between types.

overview: The reviewed Building 01 plans distinguish suite area from balconies. The four-bedroom B1-4A example includes a large outdoor deck and an illustrated pool, while smaller types use conventional balconies. Those features should not be extended to every apartment or treated as a final included specification.
research.locationNote: Madinat Jumeirah Living, Dubai, as identified by Meraas. Confirm the selected building, entrance and unit outlook on its approved plan; surrounding facilities and travel conditions can change.
research.priceNote: The own sheet gives starting guides of AED 3.68m for one bedroom, AED 4.35m for two bedrooms, AED 6.36m for two bedrooms plus maid, AED 8.36m for three bedrooms and AED 19.37m for four bedrooms. Confirm the chosen home’s current quotation, inclusions and remaining balance.
research.paymentNote: The linked developer document uses 20% booking, six construction instalments totalling 55% and 25% at anticipated handover. Some dates have already passed. This is the published release calendar, not confirmation that a new reservation receives those terms; obtain a dated unit offer and remaining-balance statement.
research.handoverNote: The official price/payment sheet prints estimated construction completion in June 2029. The dated programme remains a developer estimate and must be read with the selected unit’s sale agreement.
